title: dev-copilot: ka0s-bounded runner and bounded-runs hook
cluster_summary: All six findings are local to dev-copilot's scripts/bounded_runs.py, scripts/ka0s-bounded and scripts/test_bounded_runs.py. No upstream route applies. I re-checked them on the feature branch. The real defects are the 'command -v' false positive (DC-A-06 and DC-R-02 are one bug), which must be fixed, and the timeout using --foreground and so leaving children alive while they keep the slot lock (DC-R-01), which should be fixed. The matcher false negatives (DC-R-13), the leaked temp directories (DC-R-14) and the slot count computed once (DC-R-08) are optional. Do them in the same dev-copilot pass since the same files are open anyway. Any plugin.json version bump waits for the owner's go-ahead.

verdicts.assessment: Reproduced: check('command -v lizard') returns ['lizard'] because 'command' is in TRANSPARENT and strip_prefix skips its -v. This breaks the hook's own stated no-false-positives contract and has already blocked a real audit run. The 'MUST failure' wording refers to the repo's own contract, not to a WoW standard rule.
verdicts.remediation: Fix this together with DC-R-02 in a single commit (DC-A-06 + DC-R-02). In strip_prefix, when 'command' is followed by -v or -V, return no command. Add pass cases 'command -v lizard', 'command -V luacheck' and 'command -v luacheck lua', plus a deny case 'command luacheck .'. Update the case-count claims. Bump plugin.json only on the owner's go-ahead.

verdicts.assessment: Same root cause as DC-A-06. Its own reproduction holds, and 'command lizard .' is still correctly denied.
verdicts.remediation: Merge into the DC-A-06 fix and tests. Do not implement it separately.

verdicts.assessment: scripts/ka0s-bounded wraps the command in 'timeout --foreground -k 10'. With --foreground, the command's children are not signalled. They survive the reported 'was stopped' and keep the inherited slot fd, which bash 'exec {fd}>' leaves without close-on-exec. The LibKa0s kit's per-process timeout reduces the impact for Lua runs, but the runner's core wall-clock promise is broken.
verdicts.remediation: Pass --foreground only when [ -t 0 ], so that non-interactive runs (the Claude Bash tool) have the whole process group signalled. Update the header comment (:18-19) and DEPENDENCIES.md:47. Add BinWrapper.test_timeout_kills_children, using a short KA0S_KIT_TIMEOUT_S and KA0S_KIT_CGROUP=off, that asserts no survivor remains. Update the CLAUDE.md case count (20 to 21).

verdicts.assessment: Reproduced: bash -c "luacheck ." and 'ulimit -v unlimited; timeout 0 lua tests/run.lua' both return []. The docstring and CLAUDE.md explicitly accept false negatives on exotic shell, so this is within the documented tolerance and is not a correctness bug.
verdicts.remediation: If done, first require a numeric argument in the ulimit -v regex (\s+\d+). Scanning the -c string through segments/strip_prefix/heavy is optional, and adding it must come with pass cases showing that prose inside -c (for example bash -c 'grep lizard x') is not flagged.

verdicts.assessment: The mkdtemp calls in the test file are never removed, so each test run leaves a few empty directories in /tmp. This is hygiene only, with no correctness impact.
verdicts.remediation: Add a shared helper that calls self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, d, True) for every tempdir. The case count stays the same. Do it alongside DC-A-06 since the file is being edited anyway.

verdicts.assessment: The slot count is computed once from a single MemAvailable read before the wait loop, so a caller that started under memory pressure stays serialized on slot.1. The only effect is slower parallel sweeps, never a wrong result.
verdicts.remediation: If done, recompute the slot count from MemAvailable inside the wait loop only when KA0S_KIT_SLOTS is unset, and print the 'waiting' message only once.
